title: I Posted the Self-Checkout Scale Photo After They Accused My Bananas

parts.text: I weighed bananas at 6:33 p.m. and the attendant froze the lane for theft. The display showed the PLU and the weight I had not hidden. I was thirty-one, shopper, holding a still of the scale. Attendant Rhea said produce was a vibe. I photographed the PLU, the weight, and the freeze banner. Rhea called it a random. Random is a word freezes use when a still exists. A lead unfroze the lane and logged the still. Rhea randoms elsewhere. The bananas finally look like bananas, which is to say produce. I go back to being a person with a receipt.

social.video_title: They froze the lane on a visible banana PLU — Part 1/1
social.description: Scale still, a freeze banner, an unfrozen lane. Has produce ever been a vibe?
